沿水平方向错落有致的排列一组头像。.en-us: Arrange avatars horizontally with overlapping spacing.

配置参数`max`后，当内部头像数量超出限制时，会以省略形式展示超出部分的头像。.en-us: Configure `max` to hide avatars exceeding the display limit behind an overflow indicator.

默认情况下，鼠标悬停于省略部分之上会触发超出部分头像的显示，在配置参数`max`.en-us: By default, hovering over the overflow indicator displays hidden avatars. When `max` is configured, the trigger becomes a click.
